title: A Living Sacrifice, Marks of the True Christian

questions.question: I appeal to you therefore, brothers, by the mercies of God, to present your bodies as a ____, holy and acceptable to God.
questions.explanation: Romans 12:1 (ESV): "I appeal to you therefore, brothers, by the mercies of God, to present your bodies as a living sacrifice, holy and acceptable to God, which is your spiritual worship."

questions.question: Do not be conformed to this world, but be transformed by the ____ of your mind.
questions.explanation: Romans 12:2 (ESV): "Do not be conformed to this world, but be transformed by the renewal of your mind, that by testing you may discern what is the will of God, what is good and acceptable and perfect."

questions.question: For by the grace given to me I say to everyone among you not to think of himself more highly than he ought to think, but to think with ____.
questions.explanation: Romans 12:3 (ESV): "For by the grace given to me I say to everyone among you not to think of himself more highly than he ought to think, but to think with sober judgment, each according to the measure of faith that God has assigned."

questions.question: For as in one body we have many members, and the members do not all have the same function, so we, though many, are ____ in Christ.
questions.explanation: Romans 12:4-5 (ESV): "For as in one body we have many members, and the members do not all have the same function, so we, though many, are one body in Christ, and individually members one of another."

questions.question: Having gifts that differ according to the grace given to us, what are we to do with the gift of prophecy?
options: Use it in proportion to our faith
Deliver it with boldness and clarity
Submit it to the elders for testing
Use it for building up the church
questions.correctAnswer: Use it in proportion to our faith
questions.explanation: Romans 12:6 (ESV): "Having gifts that differ according to the grace given to us, let us use them: if prophecy, in proportion to our faith;"

questions.question: Let love be genuine. Abhor what is evil; hold fast to ____.
questions.explanation: Romans 12:9 (ESV): "Let love be genuine. Abhor what is evil; hold fast to what is good."

questions.question: Love one another with brotherly affection. Outdo one another in ____.
questions.explanation: Romans 12:10 (ESV): "Love one another with brotherly affection. Outdo one another in showing honor."

questions.question: Do not be slothful in zeal, be ____, serve the Lord.
questions.explanation: Romans 12:11 (ESV): "Do not be slothful in zeal, be fervent in spirit, serve the Lord."

questions.question: Rejoice in hope, be patient in ____, be constant in prayer.
questions.explanation: Romans 12:12 (ESV): "Rejoice in hope, be patient in tribulation, be constant in prayer."

questions.question: Contribute to the needs of the saints and seek to show ____.
questions.explanation: Romans 12:13 (ESV): "Contribute to the needs of the saints and seek to show hospitality."

questions.question: Bless those who persecute you; bless and do not ____ them.
questions.explanation: Romans 12:14 (ESV): "Bless those who persecute you; bless and do not curse them."

questions.question: Rejoice with those who rejoice, ____.
questions.explanation: Romans 12:15 (ESV): "Rejoice with those who rejoice, weep with those who weep."

questions.question: Live in harmony with one another. Do not be haughty, but associate with the ____.
questions.explanation: Romans 12:16 (ESV): "Live in harmony with one another. Do not be haughty, but associate with the lowly. Never be wise in your own sight."

questions.question: Beloved, never avenge yourselves, but leave it to the wrath of God, for it is written, "____ is mine, I will repay, says the Lord."
questions.explanation: Romans 12:19 (ESV): "Beloved, never avenge yourselves, but leave it to the wrath of God, for it is written, 'Vengeance is mine, I will repay, says the Lord.'"

questions.question: Do not be overcome by evil, but overcome evil with ____.
questions.explanation: Romans 12:21 (ESV): "Do not be overcome by evil, but overcome evil with good."

key_verse_text: I appeal to you therefore, brothers, by the mercies of God, to present your bodies as a living sacrifice, holy and acceptable to God, which is your spiritual worship. Do not be conformed to this world, but be transformed by the renewal of your mind...
